steps.content: You're all alone now.

steps.speaker: Bunny Mascot
steps.content: Welcome to the Carnival! Welcome to the Carnival!

steps.speaker: Bunny Mascot
steps.content: Welcome—! Welcome—!
The bunny mascot is beating the drum cheerfully, as if mocking your overconfidence.
You were too conceited. You thought if you kept on fighting, you could keep advancing. You underestimated the Blissful Illusion, and you underestimated Hamel.
You brought the two of them into the Black Ring, and now you've lost them.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Go back, leave this place.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: You'll only get lost if you stay for too long, lost on the way to see her...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: This is Hamel's park, if she doesn't want to see you, you'll never get to see her.
The two of them came for you. Enduring fear and pain, just because you asked, they stepped inside the Black Ring again. It was all about you, but you've gotten them into this and put them in danger.
You have no way back, you can't leave. You have to rescue them, you must rescue them. Now that this has happened, it's impossible to stop fighting now. You step forward.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: What can you do all by yourself?
...You've got nothing to lose, at least.
But as soon as you take a step forward, someone grabs your arm.

steps.speaker: (Transition)
steps.content: Fade in portrait of Hecate with her head bowed

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Don't go... Please...
Hecate mumbles with her trembling voice. You don't know what kind of painful dream she's having, but you're surprised to see that usually expressionless girl become so vulnerable.
You recall that she's also stifled a few comments and forced herself to follow your orders before.
So this is what she's been wanting to say. She's feeling so anxious just because of you.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Go back, that's her wish too.
You've been shouldering this alone and been tensed up for so long. In your mind, the Black Ring has never been gone. It weighs down on your everything heavily, distracting you from everything else.
Strangely enough, seeing someone feel so genuinely worried for you and willing to risk their life for you, you feel the weight you've been carrying alone get lifted off you gently.
At the other end of the shackles, in the depths of the mist, someone still cares about you. Just realizing this clears the despair you were feeling about the hopeless plight before you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Please... Please...
She still refuses to let go. You don't struggle free from her grip, but instead you turn around to hug her gently.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Please....

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The owner of the illusory realm means no harm. I only want to talk to her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: More importantly, the shackles are still here, still linking you and me together. I'm not fighting alone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thank you for always protecting me.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let go... This time, it's my turn to protect you.

steps.content: Hecate's hand is shaking, trying to hold onto you tightly, but the red light gleaming around her collarbones is slowly making that harder for her.
She finally releases her hand. This is the first shackles you've ever given, an absolute order a Sinner cannot defy.
You lead Hecate, who has ceased resisting, to the old man. You stoop down to talk to him while facing him at eye level.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Go back... You...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Sir, I'm going to meet Hamel.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Could you please look after this child for me? I'm sure she'll be safe next to you.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: The park doesn't welcome you... Hamel, she's not going to see you...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: That's okay, I'm the one to go see her.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: ...You're going alone...?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Yes, I'm going to bring them back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The people I care about the most are trapped in the Carnival, I can't leave them there all alone.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: ..You care about the most...
In a daze, he lifts his gaze to look at you, seemingly trying to recall something or trying his best to look at your face.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: ...Me too...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: I want to... bring her back too...
His voice changes. The old man fishes out a locket from the front of his clothing and opens it. There's a slightly faded photo inside.
In the picture is a beautiful woman with sea-blue hair and rose-red eyes. She is staring into the camera quietly and smiling gently.
The old man doesn't answer your question, but murmuring to himself tremulously.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: I want to see her again too... I want to watch her dance again...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Please... bring her back...

steps.speaker: Heh, it's only been a few years since the Abel incident, and Bernadette still has her sights on the Speaker's position... I don't think the Cavendish family will be able to come back from this ever again.
steps.content: Don't leave her by herself... I didn't want to... leave her all alone...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: I want to... apologize to her...
He looks up at you, and through those murky eyes, you see rose-red irises resembling the ones in the picture.
You take the old man's locket.
The illusory realm has amplified your senses. You feel the heavy longing the locket carries, as well as a familiar aura—that of a Sinner, that of the illusory realm's owner.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Shackles, take me where the person in the picture is.

steps.content: Red light glows in your hand gripping the locket, transforming into thorns that meander forward. You follow them.
You pass through the entrance you've returned to countless times, and pass through colorful ribbons flying in the air—
Passing through the parade, the music and cheers slowly fading—
Under the shackles' guidance, you find a tranquil lake and see the woman in the picture.
Amid the dense mist, many photo frames are floating above the lake. At the center of the lake, she's dressed in a white dance costume and leaning against a photo frame, dozing in frozen time.
She opens her eyes slightly.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: ...The audience is here...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I have to start dancing...
The tips of her toes tap the surface of the lake, stirring up ripples. The Dancer has gone onto her stage.
